name: Generativ AI (GenAI)
definition: Builds solutions where AI models generate text, code, images or other content, and knows their strengths, limits and costs.

name: LLM (Large Language Models)
definition: Selects, integrates and evaluates large language models (e.g. GPT, Claude, Llama) in applications, including hosting, cost and data handling.

name: Agentisk AI / AI-agenter
definition: Designs AI agents that plan and carry out multi-step tasks with tools and APIs, with guardrails and human oversight.

name: Multi-agent-system / orkestrering
definition: Designs systems where several AI agents cooperate, including role split, hand-offs, orchestration and failure handling.

name: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
definition: Builds retrieval-augmented generation: grounding LLM answers in the organisation's own documents and data via search and retrieval.

name: Prompt engineering / context engineering
definition: Writes and tests prompts, instructions and context (system prompts, examples, retrieved data) so models give reliable results.

name: Vektordatabaser / embeddings
definition: Uses embeddings and vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Azure AI Search) for semantic search, matching and RAG.

name: Fine-tuning
definition: Adapts pre-trained models to a domain or task by fine-tuning on own data, incl. data preparation, training and evaluation.

name: MCP (Model Context Protocol)
definition: Builds and connects MCP servers and clients so AI assistants and agents can use tools, data sources and systems in a standard way.

name: Machine Learning / Deep Learning
definition: Builds, trains and evaluates machine learning and deep learning models for prediction, classification, vision or similar.

name: NLP / Conversational AI / chatbotar
definition: Builds solutions that understand or produce natural language, such as chatbots, voice assistants, classification and text analysis.

name: Intelligent automation / Agentic process automation
definition: Automates business processes by combining RPA, workflow tools and AI agents that read documents, decide and act.

name: MLOps / LLMOps
definition: Runs ML/LLM models in production: deployment, versioning, monitoring, retraining, cost control and CI/CD for models.

name: AI-ready data / datastrategi
definition: Prepares an organisation's data for AI: data strategy, quality, ownership, access, metadata and governance.

name: Data lakehouse / Data platform
definition: Designs and builds data platforms (lakehouse, warehouse, e.g. Databricks, Fabric, Snowflake) that AI and analytics run on.

name: Evaluering / observability
definition: Measures and monitors AI quality in use: test sets, evaluation of answers, tracing, drift and user feedback.

name: Microsoft Copilot / M365 Copilot
definition: Introduces and gets value from Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat: licensing, data access, adoption and use cases.

name: Copilot Studio / Azure AI Foundry
definition: Builds custom copilots and agents with Copilot Studio and Azure AI Foundry, connected to company data and systems.

name: Azure OpenAI / OpenAI API
definition: Builds applications on OpenAI models via Azure OpenAI or the OpenAI API, incl. security, quotas and responsible use.

name: AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex AI
definition: Builds generative AI solutions on AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI, incl. model choice, integration and governance.

name: LangChain / LangGraph / Semantic Kernel
definition: Develops LLM applications and agents with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or Semantic Kernel.

name: Python / PyTorch / Hugging Face
definition: Develops AI and data solutions in Python with libraries such as PyTorch and Hugging Face.

name: GitHub Copilot / AI-assisterad utveckling
definition: Uses AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) effectively and introduces them in development teams.

name: ServiceNow Now Assist / AIOps
definition: Applies AI in IT operations: ServiceNow Now Assist, AIOps, event correlation and automated incident handling.

name: EU AI Act / AI-förordningen
definition: Interprets the EU AI Act for an organisation: risk classes, obligations, documentation and compliance work.

name: AI governance / Responsible AI / AI-etik
definition: Sets up AI governance: policies, roles, responsible and ethical AI principles, and oversight of AI use.

name: AI-risk och säkerhet
definition: Identifies and manages AI-specific risks and security threats, e.g. prompt injection, data leakage, bias and model misuse.

name: AI-strategi / AI-roadmap / AI-mognad
definition: Develops AI strategy and roadmap from business goals, and assesses an organisation's AI maturity.

name: Use case-identifiering / AI-värdeskapande / ROI
definition: Finds and prioritises AI use cases and estimates their business value, cost and ROI.

name: AI-transformation / förändringsledning / AI-adoption
definition: Leads AI transformation: change management, training and adoption so new AI ways of working stick.
